description: carbon6's render kit: documents and decks to PDF, Word, OpenDocument and PowerPoint, slides to pictures, and Word, PowerPoint and Markdown files into documents.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Prints an HTML file (a document, or a deck with a page per slide) to PDF.

tools.name: slides
tools.description: A PNG per slide of a deck's HTML (slide-01.png …) in the folder out; first and last (from 1, 0: all) pick some.

tools.name: odt
tools.description: A Markdown document to OpenDocument text.

tools.name: pptx
tools.description: A deck (deck.json, with deck.html for its pictures) to PowerPoint: titles, text, bullets and notes editable; html, chart and diagram slides as pictures.

tools.name: odp
tools.description: A deck to OpenDocument presentation (through PowerPoint).

tools.name: import
tools.description: A Word, OpenDocument, PowerPoint or Markdown file to carbon6 Markdown (a deck's slides separated by ---) in out.
